Supervises Operations Support Specialists overseeing productivity and efficiency in one or more program areas such as human resources, recruitment, position and performance management, telework, benefits, and new employee orientation.
Assigns work based on priorities, considering assignment complexity and employee capabilities; sets and adjusts short-term priorities and target dates for work completion.

The qualifications for this position must be met by 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on 07/30/2026. Current Federal employees must have served 52 weeks at the lower grade or equivalent grade band in the Federal service. The Time-in-Grade requirement must be met by 11:59 PM (Eastern Time) on 07/30/2026.

GS-13: You qualify at the GS-13 level if you possess one (1) year of specialized experience, which is equivalent to at least the GS-12 level in the federal government, that equipped you with the skills needed to successfully perform the duties of the position.

You must have experience performing the majority of the following duties: Managing the resolution of issues impacting administrative programs and customer service, including areas such as human resources, position management, staffing, performance management, and benefits.

Utilizing and modifying established practices to resolve administrative program challenges, including those that are unique or complex.

Analyzing programs, processes, and systems to develop and maintain efficient operations; Coordinating with internal and external partners to support human resources and staffing functions, such as recruitment, onboarding, position management, workforce planning, employee relations, or personnel administration.

Leading administrative management tasks and regularly communicating progress, issues, and recommendations to managers to support informed decision-making.

Please read the following important information to ensure you submit everything we need to consider your application: It is your responsibility to ensure that you submit your responses and appropriate documentation prior to 07/30/2026. You must upload your resume under the "Resume" category.

Resumes submitted under the "Other Documents" category will not be considered. Your most recently submitted resume will be used to determine your qualifications for the position advertised in this announcement.

Therefore, your resume must highlight your most relevant, significant experience related to the requirements found in the qualification section of this announcement, as well as any applicable education. Limit your resume to no more than two pages.

The USAJOBS database will not allow an applicant to submit an application that includes a resume over two pages. To help ensure your resume remains clear and easy to read, we recommend using margins of at least 0.8 inches and a font size of at least 11 point.

Be clear and specific when describing your work history since Human Resources cannot make assumptions regarding your experience. Your application will be rated and ranked based on your responses to the online questions.

Please ensure EACH work history includes ALL of the following information: Job Title (include series and grade if Federal Job) Duties (be specific in describing your duties) Employer's name and address Supervisor name and phone number Start and end dates including month, day and year (e.g.

June 18 2007 to April 05 2008) Start and end dates for each grade/pay level if you've held a federal position.

Full-time or part-time status (include hours worked per week) Salary Determining length of General or Specialized Experience is dependent on the above information and failure to provide the above information may result in a finding of ineligible.

Note: Overstating your qualifications and/or experience in your application materials or application questionnaire may result in your removal from consideration.

Federal Experience: If you are using current or prior federal experience as a basis for qualifying for this position, the grade levels and length of employment (mm/dd/year) at each grade level must be listed in your work history. This information will be further validated if selected for this position.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build criteria competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer service.

Swagger Management: Management of inquiries to internal and external services (clients) Knowledge about "Front-End" and "Backend" concepts Understanding Video Player and Video Streaming Understanding of Networking, DRM, Encoding and CDN is a plus Mandatory: Intermediate or Advanced knowledge in at least 1 of the 5 points.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; in Spanish and English (essential condition) What will you get from us? We know that extraordinary people do not choose their jobs based only on the benefits, but we make a great effort to make sure that each of us who are part of Toolbox can achieve success and improve every day.

About the Team Besides hiring the best tales, we believe diversity in terms of perspectives, ideas and cultures helps creating the best products and solutions. At Toolbox we work with cutting edge technology to build robust, high availability systems, able to handle high load and concurrency.

We look for people bringing fresh ideas from the high concurrency system design, non-structured data organization, distributed computing, API design and Mobile areas. As a member of the Development team, you will work in a project critical to our success, with the chance to switch products as our portfolio evolves.

We need versatile people, who enjoy challenges at every stage of the development cycle, who push the envelope and make things happen. Toolbox will always be a technology company. We hire people throughout the technical spectrum, who impact the life of millions of people through their work. Originally posted on Himalayas

Mercury is evolving how we think about Quality — moving from a primarily scorecard-based model toward an insights-driven, coaching-focused approach that helps teams learn, improve, and scale responsibly.
We're looking for a Senior Quality Analyst to join us during this evolution. This role sits at the intersection of quality expertise, AI-assisted analysis, and cross-functional partnership—supporting compliance and integrity work while helping us leverage AI to better understand customer interactions at scale and translate those insights into meaningful improvements.
*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Drive quality consistency and operational integrity: Review customer interactions to assess compliance, risk, and quality standards, applying strong judgment in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios. Lead and contribute to calibration efforts that strengthen fairness, alignment, and consistency across quality evaluations.
Deliver behavior-based quality insights: Provide thoughtful, actionable feedback on customer interactions, identifying strengths, opportunities, and recurring behaviors that support coaching, skill development, and performance improvement.
Investigate patterns and uncover meaningful signals at scale: Leverage AI-assisted tools, QA data, and qualitative analysis to identify recurring behaviors, risks, and opportunity areas across large volumes of customer interactions, surfacing trends that would be difficult to identify through manual review alone.
Connect insights to root causes and operational improvements: Distinguish between agent behavior, process gaps, and product or tooling issues to identify root causes and translate findings into actionable recommendations for quality processes, workflows, and customer experience improvements.
Translate insights into coaching and cross-functional action: Synthesize patterns and signals into clear, actionable guidance for Leadership, Enablement, and cross-functional partners, helping drive follow-through and measurable improvements across support operations.
Contribute to the evolution of the Quality model: Support experimentation, iterative improvement, and new approaches to understanding customer interactions at scale as Mercury continues evolving toward a more insights-driven, AI-assisted Quality function.

2–4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or a related Customer Experience role, ideally in a fast-paced, operationally complex, or regulated environment
Strong quality judgment and systems thinking: You can evaluate how work is done — not just outcomes — and identify patterns, root causes, and opportunities for improvement across people, processes, and tooling
Insight generation and problem-solving skills : You’re able to investigate open-ended questions using QA data, qualitative examples, and AI-assisted analysis, translating patterns into clear, actionable recommendations that support coaching and operational improvement
Cross-functional communication and influence: You build trust across teams, communicate insights clearly, surface risks and gaps proactively, and help stakeholders align on actions and move improvement efforts forward through strong follow-through and coordination
Ownership, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset: You operate effectively in evolving environments, move ideas into action with minimal guidance, and proactively identify ways to improve systems, workflows, and quality practices over time
AI-assisted quality tooling experience: Experience using AI-assisted analysis tools (such as Rippit, Claude, or similar platforms) to investigate customer interactions, identify meaningful patterns, and support operational decision-making. Curiosity and experience refining prompts or queries to improve signal quality and reduce noise is highly valued.

This is more than a job; it's a launchpad for your federal HR career. You will gain hands-on experience and develop a broad foundation of skills in a dynamic, supportive environment. Your work will directly impact the well-being of our employees and the success of our organization.

As part of a team, you will learn one of the core functions of federal human resources from the ground up. As an Operations Support Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our HR team.

While all roles share core responsibilities in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our employee data, you will be assigned to a specialized team where you can deepen your expertise.

Your specific duties will be focused within one of the following key HR functions: Core Responsibilities (All Teams): Be a Guardian of Data Integrity: Process a wide range of personnel actions with precision, interpreting federal guidelines to apply correct processing codes and legal justifications, ensuring every detail is accurate and every employee's record is secure.

Potential Areas of Specialization: Recruitment and Placement: Shape our workforce by playing a direct role in attracting top talent. You'll prepare recruitment packages, draft compelling job announcements for a variety of federal roles, and ensure a smooth and compliant hiring process.

Classification and Position Management: Master the art of organizational design by helping to determine appropriate job titles, series, and pay grades, ensuring fairness and equity across the agency.

You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: 4-year course of study leading to a bachelor's degree or a bachelor's degree. GS-07: A qualified candidate's online application and resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the next lower grade level (GS-05) in the Federal service.

Specialized experience for this position is defined as: experience 1) applying organizational policies and procedures to process a range of personnel or administrative actions; AND 2) providing frontline support for a human resources function (e.g. staffing, benefits administration, employee records, employee/labor relations, etc.) and responding to routine inquiries from employees, managers, or customers.

You may substitute education for specialized experience as follows: One year of graduate-level education, or superior academic achievement (S.A.A.) gained in a bachelor degree curriculum that is qualifying for the position to be filled (based on class standing, grade-point average, or honor society membership).

We’re looking for a Customer Support Systems & Analytics Lead to own the data strategy and reporting function within the Customer Support organisation at Mercury. As our operations grow in complexity—spanning multiple channels, an expanding BPO model, and sophisticated AI automation—we are moving away from fragmented, project-based data support toward a model of holistic ownership.
In this role, you will be responsible for how we capture, structure, and connect data across our CS systems - including Zendesk and our AI Agent - to drive informed decision-making across the team.

You will ensure our systems are configured in a way that produces reliable, high-quality data, and you will translate that data into actionable insights for CS leadership and stakeholders.

You’ll sit at the intersection of data, operations, and customer experience, partnering closely with CS leadership, Strategy and Ops, and cross-functional teams like Data to make sure our reporting infrastructure is built to scale.

Your work will be foundational to how the CS organisation measures performance, identifies opportunities, and drives decision-making.

Unified reporting and analytics: Actively build and maintain reports and dashboards that give the CS organisation clear visibility into key performance metrics, trends, and performance across channels, teams and projects - from our internal Support team to our BPO partners.
CS Systems configuration and data governance: Work closely with systems admins to advise on the structural setup of our Zendesk instance across customer-facing teams, ensuring it is configured to generate clean, consistent, and reliable data while maintaining secure systems and efficient workflows.
Data hygiene standards: Define and enforce standards for how data is captured across CS systems so that reporting is accurate, trustworthy, and reproducible
AI automation data oversight: Monitor and analyse data from our AI chatbot, ensuring it is tracked in a way that supports quality reviews and decision-making across the CS organisation
Insights to action: Translate raw data and reporting into clear recommendations that help CS leadership make decisions on resourcing, tooling, process improvements, and strategy
Stakeholder support: Partner with cross-functional partners in areas like Product, Data and Strategic Finance to understand their data needs and deliver reporting that supports their goals
Systems evaluation: Assess the data capabilities of existing and new CS tools, and make recommendations on how to optimise our systems stack for better reporting outcomes
Process documentation: Document data structures, reporting methodologies, and system configurations to ensure institutional knowledge is retained and accessible across the team

​ The Floating Medical Office Customer Service position provides temporary administrative coverage to different medical practices when staffing gaps occur due to vacations, sick leave, resignations, increased workload, or other unexpected absences.

Unlike an assistant dedicated to a single client, the floating assistant must be able to quickly adapt to different providers, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols while maintaining service quality and minimizing disruption to the client.

The position follows a rapid deployment model, meaning the floating assistant is not permanently assigned to a fixed group of clients. Instead, onboarding is provided when coverage is required for a specific medical practice.
Responsibilities Responsibilities will depend on the workflows and operational requirements of each assigned medical practice and may include:
Following appointment scheduling rules and provider preferences.
Supporting insurance workflows.
Assisting with referral processes.
Supporting prior authorization procedures.
Following patient communication protocols and telephone scripts.
Following established escalation procedures.
Maintaining internal documentation standards.
Navigating Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.
Reviewing and following client-specific documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Following daily operational processes and checklists.
Adapting to different medical practices, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols.

s.h: Must have your own device and headset
s.t:
High-speed internet connection of at least 100 MB.
Previous experience working with U.S.-based medical offices and knowledge of HIPAA regulations.
Ability to quickly adapt to different medical practices, providers, workflows, and operational protocols.
Ability to continuously learn and transition between different client environments.
Ability to learn and navigate different Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems and software platforms.
Ability to understand and follow practice-specific scheduling rules, insurance workflows, referral processes, prior authorization procedures, and patient communication protocols.
Ability to follow telephone scripts, escalation procedures, and internal documentation standards.
Ability to review and follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational guides, and daily checklists.
Ability to work effectively following an accelerated onboarding process for each new assignment.

s.h: Previous experience with medical offices is preferred.
s.t:
Systems Medical practices may use different software platforms, including:
Athenahealth
eClinicalWorks
Nextech
HealthArc
EMA
Other proprietary systems
The position requires the ability to understand not only the software used by each practice, but also the operational processes and procedures established by that particular medical office.

s.h: Assignment and Onboarding Model When coverage is required
s.t:
A client reports an upcoming absence or unexpected staffing need.
A floating assistant is assigned.
The assistant receives an accelerated onboarding.
The assistant reviews the client's documentation.
The assistant begins providing temporary coverage until the assigned employee returns.
Because medical offices may operate differently, each assignment may require adaptation to new workflows, provider preferences, software systems, and operational procedures. Comprehensive client documentation, structured onboarding, and ongoing support during the initial stages of each assignment are key components of the floating coverage model.

Who we are ⬇️
Thinkific is an award-winning learning commerce platform built for scale. By bringing together community, courses, and content with commerce, we power transformative learning experiences and give businesses everything they need to grow their revenue— all from one AI-powered platform.
We’re a team of 300+ Thinkers building products that matter. Every role at Thinkific contributes to raising the bar for online learning, supporting thousands of learning businesses, and creating real-world impact for millions of learners around the world. You’ll work alongside curious, collaborative teammates who care deeply about what they build and who they build it for.
We’re committed to a fair, inclusive, and human hiring experience. Our team is here to guide you every step of the way, so you always know what to expect!

Are you energized by providing an excellent customer experience and sharing your knowledge to help people solve their problems? We’re looking for a Product Support Specialist to join our Support team at Thinkific.
Thinkific’s Support Team is fueled by empathy and a genuine commitment to the customer experience. Every support interaction accelerates each learning business' unique path to success. We live by our Mantra ‘Serve the individual’ , which emphasizes understanding and addressing the unique needs, challenges, and goals of each customer.
In this omni-channel role, you will be a key driver for delivering on our vision across all communication channels. You will work directly with our customers—from self-serve to our highest-value Premium creators—through live chat, email, and scheduled phone/screen-share calls . You will role model best-in-class support, identify process improvements, and uphold our standards of excellence while helping each learning business extract the most value from our product to fuel their success.

Hours: 9am-5pm PST
Schedules: Monday-Friday
Statutory holiday coverage rotates among the team and is scheduled well in advance, allowing you to plan accordingly. In these scenarios you will receive a day in lieu of the holiday coverage.
Your goal will be to drive best-in-class customer experiences. Here’s how you’ll accomplish this:
1. Deliver Exceptional Multi-Channel Support
Provide timely, empathetic, and technically accurate responses via live chat, email, and phone/screen-share .
Own each customer issue from initial report through resolution, coordinating with Technical Support and Product teams as needed.
Troubleshoot complex platform issues, including domain connections, payment errors, and integration timeouts.
Investigate and resolve issues involving payment processors, SSO, and other authentication errors.
Identify, reproduce, and document bugs, while ensuring clear hand-offs to downstream technical teams.
2. Help Customers Succeed & Grow
Go beyond reactive troubleshooting—educate customers on best practices, features, and integrations to help them scale.
Utilize opportunities for product adoption and plan upgrades (e.g., Thinkific Plus and Branded Mobile).
Spot early churn signals and collaborate with Support and Customer Success teams to retain and grow customers.
Manage and own complex customer escalations with sound judgment and calm professionalism.

Wir von der CSS helfen Menschen, ein gesundes Leben zu führen - was immer das Leben für sie bereithält. Vielleicht ist unsere Mission ja bald auch deine? Uns würde es freuen. Wir sind eine bunte Gruppe ehrgeiziger Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

Einige von uns haben das KV gemacht, andere kommen aus dem Detailhandel, dem Gastgewerbe oder aus einer anderen beruflichen Ecke. Alle bringen ihre Erfahrung ein. Was uns verbindet, ist unsere Leidenschaft für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden da zu sein. Wir helfen einander, halten zusammen und lachen viel.

Und Erfolge feiern wir am liebsten gemeinsam im Team.
## **So sieht dein Alltag aus** ##
* Zum Herzstück: Du überzeugst Menschen von der CSS und machst sie zu Kundinnen und Kunden.
* Diese berätst du persönlich, am Telefon, per E-Mail oder auch mal per Video-Call - in sehr gutem Deutsch, gerne auch in weiteren Sprachen.
* Unser Kundenportfolio wächst dank dir durch Cross- und Upselling.
* Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und ihr unterstützt euch gegenseitig beim Erreichen der gemeinsamen Ziele.
* Ab und zu schaust du über den Tellerrand und übernimmst Zusatzaufgaben oder Projektarbeiten.
## **Das bringst du mit** ##
* Das Wichtigste zuerst: Man merkt dir an, dass du gerne unter Menschen bist - du gehst offen auf sie zu und deine positive Art ist ansteckend.
* Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich, im Detailhandel oder in einem anderen spannenden Beruf - im Idealfall mit Kundenkontakt.
* Idealerweise verfügst du über Erfahrung in der Krankenversicherungsbranche und hast bereits das VBV-Zertifikat erworben - und wenn nicht, unterstützen wir dich dabei.
* Du kannst gut auf dein Gegenüber eingehen, hörst zu und liebst es, andere im Gespräch mit starken Argumenten zu überzeugen.
* Die Digitalisierung ist für dich kein Fremdwort - du kannst gut mit dem Computer umgehen.
* Du hast ein grosses Beziehungsnetz und wohnst vorzugsweise in der Region.

About Smithey Ironware
At Smithey Ironware , we’re building the next great American cookware company - one rooted in craftsmanship, quality, and enduring design. As a privately owned and fast-growing brand, we take a long-term approach to growth and decision-making.

We believe exceptional products come from thoughtful work, high standards, and people who care deeply about what they do. Our team is united by a commitment to excellence, continuous improvement, and creating cookware that will be trusted and enjoyed for generations to come.
About the Engagement
Smithey Ironware is a privately owned American cookware company making heirloom-quality cast iron and carbon steel. Our customers buy pieces they intend to pass down for generations, and our customer service is held to thatsame standard.
This engagement covers seasonal customer support from October through January, when customer volume rises sharply through the holidays. Smithey is contracting for experienced support capacity that can step in quickly, work independently, and requires no ramp-up or training.
Smithey's brand standard is that every email, text, and phone call is answered by a person who reads carefully and responds by hand. Automated or AI-generated customer replies do not meet the standard.
This is a 1099 contract engagement rather than employment. The contractor supplies their own computer, headset, and internet connection, sets their own hours within agreed coverage windows, invoices Smithey for hours worked, and is free to take on other clients during the term.
Scope of Services
Customer Contact
Respond to customer inquiries by phone, email, and SMS.
Resolve product questions, order concerns, returns, tracking requests, and exchanges.
Produce written replies that are clear, warm, and personal, composed for each customer rather than generated or templated.
Systems and Records
Work in Smithey's Shopify, help desk, returns, and phone platforms to manage tickets and orders.
Maintainaccuraterecords of customer interactions in those systems.
Coverage
Commit to weekly coverage volume and coverage windows agreed with Smithey at the start of the engagement, including elevated coverage in the weeks around Thanksgiving and the December holidays.
Determineyour own working hours and daily schedule within those agreed windows.
What Success Looks Like
Customers get fast,accurate, human answers, and response time targets are met through peak weeks.
Tickets are resolved rather than deferred, and order and return records areaccurate.
Agreed coverage windows are staffed without day-to-day oversight from Smithey.
Required Skills & Abilities
Prior customer service experience in a direct-to-consumer or ecommerce environment. This is the most important qualification.
Hands-on experience with help desk or ticketing systems (Zendesk, Gorgias,Re:amaze, or similar) and comfort working across several tools at once.
Familiarity with Shopify.
Excellent written communication, and confidence composing clear, kind, helpful replies from scratch.
Comfortable and professional on the phone.
Self-directed and reliable, able to work independently in a remote setting with minimal oversight.
Available for the full October through January term.
